digest.component_or_area: graph module and ticket unblock detection
propositions: The _same_level_neighbors function contains two separate guards (inline CURRENT-side and _is_at_level TARGET-side) that confine graph traversal to the same level; both guards must be exercised to prevent cross-level edge traversal
A direct cross-level edge whose target is the queried source_id will flip the cycle detection result from False to True if the _is_at_level guard is deleted

The _load_states_with_tombstones function contains three branches for handling tombstoned blockers that produce a status-only stub when reduce returns None, override reduced status with tombstone status, and degrade malformed tombstones to deleted status
Tombstone status propagates verbatim when reduce returns None and a tombstone is present, only observable when the recorded status is non-terminal
A malformed or unparseable tombstone must degrade to deleted status rather than absent status to correctly evaluate blocking edges
The existing inline traversal logic was uncovered by tests despite being valid behavior, and naming it as explicit helpers made the gaps visible without introducing regressions
